definitions.explanation: The planet Earth and all its inhabitants.
A particular area of activity or experience.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{中|じゅう}を{旅行|りょこう}したい。
examples.english: I want to travel around the world.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}の{世界|せかい}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work in the world of music.

notes: Common compounds: {世界中|せかいじゅう} (all over the world), {世界的|せかいてき} (worldwide), {世界一|せかいいち} (world's best/number one).
